t: You're at Coal Drops Yard, a shopping complex and privately owned public space that forms part of the King's Cross Central development. It opened in October 2018. The design is by Thomas Heatherwick, an English designer and the founder of Heatherwick Studio. He works with a team of about 250 architects, designers and entrepreneurs from his studio right here in King's Cross. So the person who shaped this place also works just around the corner from it, which is worth remembering as you walk through.
